item.description:
What's new in Sonault 1.8.1

  • ⌥P now previews the highlighted sound in ⌘K's Needs Credit tab, the same way it already did under Sounds.
  • Fixed a blinking cursor that appeared in the middle of the sign-in screen instead of inside the code boxes.
  • Pasting a batch of links no longer starts every download at once — Sonault now works through them a few at a time, so a big paste doesn't bog the app down.
  • Cancelling a download now stops it immediately, even if you cancel the instant it starts.
  • Deleting a sound now reliably frees its disk space, including sounds removed by a connected AI assistant.
  • Importing a multi-part recording is now all-or-nothing: if one segment fails, the rest are no longer left pointing at missing audio.
  • Turning the MCP server off in Settings now closes connections that were already open, instead of leaving them running.
  • Duplicating a sound and browsing large libraries are both noticeably faster.
